_meta.description: Registered office of every in-scope Anti-nero contractor, read from the party clause of its own signed contract (chain-read cached text), transcribed by hand; verbatim sentence kept as evidence. Where today's register (ΓΕΜΗ/VIES) or the company's own website shows the firm has since moved, the CURRENT seat is chosen (seat_source register|website) and the contract's seat is kept under contract_seat. A venture's seat is never inferred from a member's. Postal codes the document omits come from the register and say so.
rules: seat_source=contract: city/street/number/postal_code as the signed contract states them (spelling normalised: Λεωφόρος, Μεγάλου, full names), excerpt verbatim
seat_source=register|website: the contract seat is kept under contract_seat with its own excerpt; note says what decided
number None = the document states no number (km markers, localities, θέσεις); street None = the document names only a settlement
postal_code_from=register where the clause omits the Τ.Κ.
